name: chosen-and-judged
title: Scored on the draws that chose it
idea: A report chosen on posterior draws can look better or worse on them than under the exact law, though better on average; the gap is at most N/M times the draws' largest pair-probability error, which shrinks as draws grow.
from: new concept · postrank vignette m6 (fixed and selected actions; cross-fitting as the package view of fold grades) and theory book ch. 15 (the envelope covers selection on the same draws); picture: reruns of S draws, each run's chosen report scored on its own draws against its exact risk, the signed gap over runs, and the regret bound 2δ_w + η
credit: After the postrank vignette m6 and the theory book, ch. 15.
caption: Six fictional normal posteriors; reports selected from independent posterior draws and evaluated on those same draws and the exact declared law. A separate cached package toy shows fold reports.
